STATUS: ANSWER
The -l (--merge-logic) option sets how multiple annotation values are written to a tag when several regions overlap one record. The available rules are first (keep the first value and ignore the rest), append (keep duplicates), append-missing (also append values that are missing, shown as a dot), unique (append without duplicates), sum (numeric fields only), avg, min and max [bcftools_manual#h019]. It is effective only when the annotation file is BED or TAB-delimited and REF and ALT or BEG and END columns are present, and it is an experimental feature [bcftools_manual#h019].
